outcome: Type of SSI (superficial incisional, deep incisional, organ space)
cohort: 1135 women who underwent cesarean sections at Tribhuvan University Teaching Hospital, Nepal, from February 2019 to August 2019
finding: The incidence of surgical site infection following cesarean section was 8.54%, with obesity, medical complications during pregnancy, labor status during cesarean section, prolonged rupture of membrane (>18 hours), and multiple vaginal examinations (>5) identified as risk factors.
